description: The signed-in person's Outlook calendar between two dates (default: the next 7 days), recurring events expanded. Times in time_zone (IANA, default UTC). Read-only. Sign-in required.

end.description: End date or date-time (ISO). Defaults to start + 7 days.

start.description: Start date or date-time (ISO). Defaults to now.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for the times, e.g. America/Denver. Defaults to UTC.

name: list_outlook_events
title: List my Outlook calendar
